thread-tabs.description: Keep up to eight independent agent chats in one thread and workspace. Choose any installed model, fork an output into a transcript-backed tab, rename chats, and restore closed tabs. The output menu also keeps BB’s native fork into a separate thread. Requires BB 0.48.1 (0.48.x only) and your configured agent provider.

thread-tags.description: Puts a colored emoji or text badge before a thread's title, so you can spot status and topics in the sidebar at a glance. Tag a thread from the tag button in its hover controls, or create a tag there with up to 12 characters and a preset or custom color. An emoji picker lists every emoji by category and searches names in English and Russian, without network access. A Tags editor renames, recolors, and deletes tags, and the bb thread-tags command lets agents tag the thread they work in.

thread-time-machine.description: Step through everything an agent did in any thread, and diff its file changes between any two moments.Drag across a filmstrip of every message, command, file change and error, or press play, and open any frame to read its output, exit code or diff. Pin a start frame to see every file change between it and the current frame as diffs. Works on Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Muse Code, Cursor, opencode, Grok and Antigravity threads, including sub-agents, and adds frames live while an agent runs. A bb thread-time-machine dump command and a bundled agent skill print the same history as text. Read-only and local: no account or external service, and it never changes a thread.

threadspace.description: Turns the BB sidebar into a Notion-style list of projects and threads. Give each project an emoji and a Notion background colour that fills its row. Pinned threads stay at the top of their own project, and threads waiting for your answer collect in one section above the projects. One status column shows running agents, questions, errors and unread results; collapsed projects show a count of work inside.

tinted-threads.description: A tinted replacement for bb's sidebar thread list with active and blocked row hues, provider glyphs, git diff badges, and sub-thread nesting.
tinted-threads.licenseNote: файла лицензии нет на v0.1.4; текст взят с ветки по умолчанию (коммит ad96525d790ada8f0f70b30f26663a7c0bdfc65a)

token-guard.description: Stop API keys from landing in your agent chats, and find the ones already there. Rejects a message that contains a credential before it reaches the agent or thread history. Scans Claude Code, Codex and BB history on your server in one click. Lists each credential by kind and fingerprint with a link to its revoke page, and never shows, stores or sends a value.

token-pass-pace.description: See whether your Vercel Token Pass will last the billing period, before it runs out. A sidebar page charts every day of the period and projects your recent daily spend to the renewal date, naming the day you hit the limit. A footer line keeps the percentage and countdown in view. Needs a Vercel AI Gateway API key, your renewal day, and your allowance, entered once.

tokenmaxx.description: Shows every Codex and Claude Code account tokenmaxx manages, with live rate-limit windows, token analytics, account switching, auto-rotation policy, sign-in, and routing control.

tokyo-night.description: Adds the two Tokyo Night palettes (Night and Storm), each pairing its dark base with Tokyo Night Light for light mode.

top-tabs.description: Switch between the threads you are working on from a row of tabs across the top of the bb window. Every thread you open gets a tab with bb's status glyph, so a thread that is working, needs input, or has unread output shows without the sidebar. Close tabs with × or a middle-click, drag them to reorder, and cycle through them with Ctrl+Tab. Right-click a tab for bb's thread menu plus Close other tabs and Close tabs to the right. Tabs are stored per window on your machine, with no account or external service; requires bb 0.49 or later.

touchbar.description: Keep BB agent status and guarded controls on a MacBook Pro Touch Bar across every app. Open threads, follow provider usage, and switch to compact Host Monitor gauges. Requires macOS 11+, a Touch Bar Mac, and Xcode Command Line Tools; native mode uses Apple's private Touch Bar frameworks.

trace-mcp.description: See repository context and saved decisions beside every bb thread. Search code, record decisions, and reindex without leaving the thread. Native agent tools and bb trace commands keep queries compact. Runs on the environment's machine; first use needs Node.js and npm registry access. Shows provider context usage when bb reports it and does not alter quotas.

tree-sidebar.description: Find threads by where their project lives on disk: folders nest, projects sit inside them, and each thread sits under its project. Forks and side chats nest under the thread they came from. Search reads message text as well as titles, shows the matching line under each result, and lists archived matches in their own section. Hover a thread to archive it in one click, or right-click it to open it in a split, copy its link, pin it, or delete it. Optional settings sort bb's project list and indent its new-thread project picker to match the tree.

treehouse.description: Review, edit and commit every repository your agents touched, worktrees included, from a split panel beside the thread. Files, diffs and commits open as tabs next to a file tree with git badges, and you can edit a file and save it with Ctrl/⌘+S. Each repository gets staged and unstaged lists, per-hunk staging, and a commit box where Claude can write the message in your repo's style. Compare any branch with main and open a pull request on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, or click a commit in the branch graph to see its diff. Needs git on the thread's machine; the commit-message button also needs an Anthropic API key, an ant login or the claude CLI.

treelanes.description: Take each coding task from idea to merged pull request in its own Git worktree, with checks before every stage moves. A board shows one card per worktree as agents move it through Design, TDD, Quality Loop, Simplify and PR Watch. A stage moves on only when its worker reports passing checks for the current files. The sidebar lists one main thread per worktree, with its other threads below it. The task map sets the harness, model and effort for each step. Needs an agent harness such as Claude Code or Codex, and the GitHub CLI for pull requests.

triage.description: Keep agent tasks, progress, and work that needs your attention in one board. Run tasks now or schedule them, organize stages, and turn existing sessions into cards. Follow each task in its linked conversation. Requires BB 0.42+, a compatible Plugin SDK 0.4.47 runtime, and a configured agent provider; provider usage charges apply.

try-it.description: Test what your agent built from your phone, and send your verdict back with one tap per check. The agent shows a QR code, a link, what changed and a checklist in place of the composer. Each check gets Works or Broken, plus an optional note, and the answer goes straight back to the agent. Localhost links are refused, so the link you get opens on your phone.

typewriter.description: Hear IBM Selectric clicks as you type in BB, with five WAV sounds included. Set the volume, preview Enter or import a personal sound pack stored only on your device. No account, external service or OS keyboard-monitoring permission is needed.

typography.description: Set your own interface and code fonts in bb, down to size, line height, bold weight, and OpenType features. Interface size and line height scale the theme's whole type ramp, so headings and labels keep their proportions. Code settings reach inline code, code blocks, the source viewer, and diffs. A preview built from bb's own chat and source renderers shows each saved change, and every value also works from bb plugin config. Fonts must already be installed on the device that displays bb.

ui-scale.description: Makes the bb interface bigger or smaller on each device, so your phone and desktop each get a size that fits. A slider from 50% to 200% scales text, spacing, and layout, and the change applies immediately. Each browser and phone keeps its own value, stored locally and never synced. On iOS, it also stops Safari from zooming in when you tap a text field.

ui-tweaks.description: Tune BB's type, icons, prompt box, menus and shortcuts with switches that BB itself does not offer. Clearer hierarchy, on by default, makes thread titles bolder and chat text slightly larger. Switch interface icons between BB Default, Lucide, Iconoir and Tabler Outline, and give the spinner its own style. Move the new-thread prompt to the top, center or bottom, hide Steer labels, turn on richer File Editor highlighting, and hide apps from the Open With menu. Alt+1 to Alt+9 switch right-panel tabs, and settings are saved on the BB server so every device shares them. Needs BB 0.49 or newer; no account or external service.

ultra-launcher.description: Start a BB thread from any screen with Cmd+N, without leaving the thread you are in. Each thread starts from a saved preset of provider, model, reasoning level and service tier. Enter opens the new thread, and Cmd+Enter starts it in the background with an Open button in a toast. Save up to 30 presets, reorder them by dragging, and edit them in the picker or in settings. On phones the launcher opens as a bottom sheet. It takes over Cmd+N and moves BB's own New thread shortcut to Cmd+Shift+O, and one setting gives Cmd+N back. Requires BB 0.46 or later.

ultragoal.description: Keep long-running agent work moving without losing the plan when a thread ends. UltraGoal schedules dependency-ready slices across isolated workers, records defects and owner decisions durably, and can require an independent verifier before work closes. Each goal pins worker and verifier execution settings, reports host substitutions, and can replace idle clean workers one at a time. Repository integration, worktree cleanup, and local provider-data reads stay off until you enable them. Requires BB 0.39+ and Plugin SDK 0.4.8+.

uptime.description: Monitor website availability and response times from your BB server. View recent checks and see when a site is down. Requires the server to remain running and able to reach the sites.

usage.description: Tracks coding-agent token usage and estimated API cost across enrolled machines.

usage-bar.description: Keep provider quotas and reset times above the sidebar footer. Open quota details and inspect daily and monthly token totals. Requires providers that report usage to BB; Usage Limits is optional.

usage-forecast.description: Forecast whether your Claude Code and Codex limits last until reset, and see each thread's context fill above the composer. A band shows every limit window with a pace tick, the context breakdown and a Compact button, and adds a learned forecast once windows have closed. Optional auto-compact, off by default, compacts an idle thread above a threshold you set; each compact runs a turn on the thread's provider and counts against its limits. Limits appear only for providers that report them to bb, today Claude Code and Codex. The server polls bb every 2 minutes and calls no provider API.

usage-limits.description: See provider quota windows and reset times without leaving your work. View details across connected hosts and refresh on demand. Requires providers that report quota information to BB.

usage-meter.description: Shows Claude subscription limits as two rings around a sidebar footer button — the five-hour session and the week — and adds a Usage page that reads local Claude Code transcripts to explain where the limits went, broken down by project, model, thread, skill and subagent.

usage-pace.description: Tells you if your current rate lasts until each quota window resets. In bb's usage card, each bar gets a tick at even pace, and red shows how far ahead of pace you are. Hover or tap a row to see the difference, when the quota runs out, and how long you will be without quota before the reset. Adds a Grok Build tab, shows a failed provider's error on its own tab only, and hides tabs you do not use, such as Cursor. The Grok tab reads your grok login and asks xAI's billing service for the credit window; everything else uses the data bb's card already has.

usage-page.description: Tracks Claude Code, Codex, and Pi token usage with estimated API costs in a bb dashboard.

usage-tracker.description: See subscription limits without leaving BB. Track Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity, and DeepSeek in a compact sidebar summary with provider details and 80/95% warnings.

vantage.description: See every worktree your parallel agents work in, and everything they changed across repositories, from the parent thread. Each worktree shows status, branch, commits ahead and behind, uncommitted files and its pull request; open one to read its diffs and commits, talk to its agent, or start a terminal in it. Files changed in two worktrees are flagged before they conflict. A full-screen Vantage page in bb's left navigation shows every recent thread's worktrees and changed repositories at once, filtered by project. It paints at once and loads git details in the background; archived threads stay hidden on the page until you ask for them.

variaq.description: Run VariaQ classical/quantum experiments from bb. Generate problems, solve, benchmark, plan and execute campaigns, analyze results, and generate reports against a standalone VariaQ install. Supports VariaQ 0.6.x and 0.8.x including 0.8.0rc1; schema-v1 validated. Requires BB and a separate VariaQ install.

vcs-widget.description: Run Git from the bb thread header instead of a terminal: branches, commits and history, on the machine that owns the worktree. Every push, rebase and reset shows the exact git command before it runs.

vercel-theme.description: Adds a Vercel-inspired light and dark palette with Geist typography and matching code, diff, file-tree, and terminal colors.

vesper.description: Recolor BB, its diffs and its terminal in Vesper's peppermint and orange. Pick Vesper to follow BB's light or dark mode, or Vesper Dark or Vesper Light to keep one look. Diffs and file previews use Vesper's syntax colors, and the dark code theme is the original Vesper file. The plugin adds only CSS and color files and runs nothing in the background. Requires BB 0.46 or later.

visual-workflows.description: Connect specialist steps on a canvas and follow their outputs through each run. Includes local step profiles and can import independent copies from Agent Roles. Runs use your configured providers and their quotas.

voice-mode.description: Talk to a thread's agent hands-free, like ChatGPT or Codex voice. When the composer is empty its send button becomes a waveform; click it, or press Ctrl+Shift+V, for a full-duplex realtime voice chat. The voice model hands requests to the thread's agent, answers "is it done?", stops the agent when you say stop, and reads back a short summary when the turn ends. Talk over it any time to interrupt. Uses OpenAI Realtime with your own API key, or a plugin that provides realtime connections (for example a company AI proxy). bb's own send and dictation are never affected.

vps-watch.description: Keep an eye on your personal Linux VPS without installing a monitoring stack. See CPU, RAM, root disk and inode usage with absolute capacities and compact history charts. Read system counters over SSH or import an existing collector history without running duplicate measurements; the optional collector caps VPS history at 32 MiB. Requires SSH key access to Linux; optional background collection requires a separate Python 3 and Docker systemd setup, with no paid service or external API.

vscode-server.description: Embeds a self-hosted code-server or VS Code Server in a thread's right panel, opened at that thread's workspace so the editor shows the same files the agent is working on. One panel per thread, a compact header with the server URL and an Open in Browser link, and — for a loopback server — import of your desktop VS Code profile, keybindings, and extensions into it. You bring the server; the plugin embeds it and never proxies or weakens its authentication.

waiting-on-you.description: Shows which agent threads wait on your answer or failed, pinned above your thread list, so none of them sit unnoticed. Open one with a click, ⇧⌘J for the next, or ⌥⌘1–9 by its row; a thread leaves the block once you open it. Each question shows when it was asked, and counters in the title track waiting, failed, finished, and working threads. Pick a style, or tune markers, colors, row layout, and row limits on a settings page with a live preview, then move the setup between machines as JSON. Runs on your bb server only, with no account, API key, or outside service.

wakatime.description: Tracks BB agent working time locally with project, machine, model, concurrency, and activity breakdowns.

wikilinks.description: Edit Markdown notes in BB with wikilinks, recursive previews, contextual backlinks, and queryable thinking trails.

work-map.description: Spot the work that needs you and manage it without leaving the map. Expand tasks and sessions in place, keep pinned work prominent, and follow running agents and results waiting for you. Start or continue sessions, manage project areas, and leave task handoffs with Undo. Requires BB 0.43 or later and its built-in Tasks plugin; sessions use your chosen BB provider and its usual account requirements and costs.

workbench-explorer.description: Keeps a file tree beside every thread that shows what the agent changed in git colours, one click away from the diff. Quick Open finds any file from a few letters of its name, and Search in Files previews every replacement before it is written. The tree works from the keyboard: arrows, F2 to rename, Delete to move to the Trash with Undo, and Cut, Copy and Paste for files; drag and drop moves them. Files open in BB's own editor, with Material Icon Theme icons. Git colours and diffs need a git repository; the Trash works on macOS and Linux.

workspace-sidebar.description: Keep every BB thread visible as work moves across projects. Group threads by project or status, pin current work, and see subagents nested under their parent. Review pull requests, branches, failures, and scheduled work on each row. Select threads in batches to move, snooze, or finish them, and use bb sidebar from a terminal. Replaces BB's thread list and requires BB 0.46 or later.

workspaces.description: Run one agent thread across several repositories, each in its own isolated Git worktree. Group existing BB projects into a reusable workspace, then select only the repositories a task needs and start a thread rooted at all of them. Every checkout branches from its repository's own default branch, and your source clones are never pulled, checked out, or stashed. The thread's Repositories panel reports changed files and commits ahead for each checkout, and can enroll another project mid-session. Removing worktrees requires an archived session with every checkout clean and still on its recorded branch, and generated branches are never deleted. Uses local Git and BB's public plugin APIs, with no account, token, or external service.

worktree-ports.description: See which port each worktree's dev server is on, and open it in one click. The app port leads as a named pill; database, Docker, and internal listeners fold behind a toggle so nothing is hunted for. Hover a pill to stop the process or container holding it. The same listing answers `bb ports list` and the worktree_ports agent tool, so an agent can name the URL instead of guessing. Needs lsof, so macOS or Linux only; Docker ports need the docker CLI.

wterm-terminal-preview.description: Adds a Ghostty-backed terminal with independent tabs, TUI mouse input, secure file transfer, and font controls.

x-viral.description: Scores a draft X post against the open-source For You ranking weights, then runs an autoresearch loop that applies every edit that raises the score, checks dropped images and videos for the feed, and drafts a video script.

xberg.description: Lets agents read the PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, slides and images in your project. Documents are converted on the machine that holds the workspace, and the plugin uploads no files, though the extracted text reaches the agent's model. OCR reads text in images, and can be turned on for scanned documents. Long documents come back in pages of 20,000 characters by default, and the agent chooses how many to read. First use downloads the open-source Xberg CLI (50–90 MB) from GitHub; it needs 120–230 MB of disk plus caches, of up to 2 GB for text and no set limit for OCR, and runs only on Apple Silicon macOS and Linux.

xcode.description: Tracks every Xcode build and test on the machine with no per-project configuration — live progress, verdicts, errors with file:line, history and trends — and streams the simulators they run on into the panel with full touch input, a build-aware device picker, SwiftUI preview diffs, and gated agent tools.

zcode.description: Run ZCode coding agents inside bb, with streamed replies, native tool activity, approvals, and sessions you can resume and rewind. Follow every ZCode tool call in the thread timeline, answer approvals inline, and track background agents and scheduled automations. Dynamic workflows render as causality graphs with live per-agent progress, and a Workflows hub lists run history across threads. Requires bb 0.46.1, Node.js 24+, and the ZCode CLI installed separately; sessions run under your own Z.ai Coding Plan or API account, billed by Z.ai. Verified on macOS against ZCode CLI 0.16.9-0.17.0; Linux and Windows are unverified.

zcode-acp.description: Use your ZCode Coding Plan, free Start Plan and personal API models in BB. Install or update Rust ACP in settings and track each plan's quota separately. Requires BB 0.49+ and a signed-in ZCode Desktop installation on Windows or macOS. Coding Plan requires a paid subscription; personal API charges follow your provider, while Start Plan depends on an active free grant.

zcode-provider.description: Use your Z.ai GLM Coding Plan for coding tasks in bb on macOS. Choose GLM-5.3 or GLM-5.3-Flash, work with files and terminal tools, and continue saved sessions through your installed ZCode agent. Reuse Desktop sign-in and its shared store, settings and configured MCP servers; bb sessions, history and logs stay separate. Requires Apple silicon, bb 0.47.1+, Git, ZCode Desktop, an individual paid Z.ai Coding Plan and Full permissions; unofficial and unaffiliated with Z.ai, ZCode or bb.

zen-koi.description: Watch pixel-art koi swim under your chat input while the agent works, and scoop them in a one-tap catch game. When a ! shows over the paper poi, tap to lift that koi into the bowl; leave it alone and the poi plays by itself. Draw up to nine koi that grow from 15 to 45 cm over two weeks, and set the garden, season, time of day, and rain. Optional sound adds water, a wind chime, and rain in a soft reverb. Your koi and catch counts stay on your bb server and use no external service.

zh-cn.displayName: 简体中文语言包 · Simplified Chinese
zh-cn.description: Use Simplified Chinese across BB menus, settings and built-in panels while keeping project, thread and Git. Includes 5,914 translated strings and preserves dynamic names and placeholders. Chat content, code, terminals and recognized custom titles keep their original text; disabling the plugin restores the interface. Runs locally without a translation API or account; the dictionary targets BB 0.49.0 and requires BB 0.49+.
